content.text:
The image shows two benzene rings joined by a single bond (a biphenyl). The top ring carries an OMe group at the position para to that bond, so the molecule is 4-methoxybiphenyl.

There is a small dot to the right of the structure. It looks like a stray mark and not an atom, so I ignored it.

SMILES: COc1ccc(cc1)-c1ccccc1
